messages.content: Hello! How can I assist you today?

As an advanced AI agent, I don't actually have a set "schedule" or pre-assigned tasks in the traditional human sense! 😊

My operation is reactive—meaning my entire focus is currently on **you**. My schedule is essentially blank until you give me something to do!

1.  Awaiting input from the user.
2.  Analyzing requests for accuracy and intent.
